description: This Java source file defines the 'Analyser' class, which provides static and instance methods for analyzing Android navigation and UI code, including reading manifest files, extracting layout XMLs, and deriving navigation transitions and states.

classes.name: Analyser
classes.description: Main class providing static and instance methods for analyzing Android navigation and UI code, including manifest parsing, layout XML analysis, and navigation transition derivation.

classes.name: Analyser.Evaluator
classes.description: Abstract class for evaluating PsiExpressions, with a static implementation for true/false evaluation.

classes.name: Analyser.MiniModel
classes.description: Helper class holding maps of activity and menu states used during transition derivation.

classes.name: Analyser.Processor
classes.description: Abstract class defining a process method for handling matched PsiElements during searches.

classes.name: FragmentEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a fragment's class name and tag extracted from layout XML.

classes.name: ActivityState
classes.description: Represents the state of an activity, identified by class name.

classes.name: MenuState
classes.description: Represents the state of a menu, identified by menu name.

classes.name: Transition
classes.description: Represents a navigation transition between states, with type, source, and target locators.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Utility class for locating states or views in navigation modeling.

classes.name: NavigationModel
classes.description: Model representing the navigation graph with states and transitions.

methods.name: qualifyClassNameIfNecessary
methods.description: Qualifies a class name with package name if necessary.

methods.name: unQuote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits document changes for a given PsiFile.

methods.name: readManifestFile
methods.description: Reads Android manifest files from modules to extract activity class names.

methods.name: getActivityState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an ActivityState for a given class name.

methods.name: getMenuState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a MenuState for a given menu name.

methods.name: getQualifiedName
methods.description: Gets the fully qualified name of a PsiClass or PsiTypeElement.

methods.name: getActivityClassNameToActivityState
methods.description: Creates a map from activity class names to ActivityState objects.

methods.name: getXMLFileName
methods.description: Determines the layout XML filename associated with an activity or fragment class.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a recursive search over PsiElements for macro matches, applying a processor to each match.

methods.name: deriveAllStatesAndTransitions
methods.description: Builds the full navigation model by deriving states and transitions from manifest and layout XMLs.
